The '''Heavy 44.h''' was a model of double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation]]. It was designed for anti-vehicle use. Several were installed in armored turrets at [[Fortress Keremark]].<ref name="HS" />
